Let the points be  
\[
P_1=(x_1,y_1),\quad P_2=(x_2,y_2),\quad P_3=(x_3,y_3).
\]
The given equations say their pairwise distances are
\[
P_1P_2=3,\qquad P_1P_3=4,\qquad P_2P_3=5.
\]
Since
\[
3^2+4^2=5^2,
\]
the triangle is a right triangle with legs \(3\) and \(4\). Thus its area is
\[
A=\frac12(3)(4)=6.
\]

The determinant
\[
\begin{vmatrix}
x_1 & y_1 & 1\\
x_2 & y_2 & 1\\
x_3 & y_3 & 1
\end{vmatrix}
\]
equals twice the signed area of the triangle. Therefore its square is
\[
(2A)^2=4A^2=4(6^2)=4\cdot 36=144.
\]

The answer is 144.
